purpose: Close mandatory walk-forward, regime and placebo evidence gaps found by the final completion audit.

walk_forward.parameter_grid: the same frozen 27-neighbor grid already archived
walk_forward.selection_rule: highest annualized Sharpe on all observations through the prior calendar year; ties by variant name

overlays.liquidity_contraction: prior-session 20-day mean amount / trailing-250 median amount <= 0.60
overlays.extreme_market_day: same-day absolute SH510300 return >= 3%; descriptive attribution only

placebo.schedule: for each calendar month independently choose one of the first six trading sessions; observe the immediately prior session and trade at the chosen session open

decision_rule: All gates must pass to retain R2. Failure downgrades this engineering candidate to R1; results are retained and no historical repair is allowed.
